Convert a Resource Specification into SLURM CLI Flags

Source: R/resources.R
as_slurm_flags.Rd

Formats a slurmpilot_resources object into canonical SLURM --flag=value directives suitable for sbatch headers or command-line submission.

Usage

as_slurm_flags(x, array_indices = NULL, ...)

# S3 method for class 'slurmpilot_resources'
as_slurm_flags(x, array_indices = NULL, ...)

Arguments

x

Object to format (typically a slurmpilot_resources object).

array_indices

Optional integer vector overriding the --array range (used during surgical retries of specific failed chunks).

...

Additional arguments passed to methods.

Value

Character vector of SLURM flags (e.g. c("--array=1-10", "--mem=2G", ...)).

Examples

res <- resource_spec(n_tasks = 20, chunk_size = 5, mem_mb = 2048, time_minutes = 30)
as_slurm_flags(res)
#> [1] "--array=1-4"       "--cpus-per-task=1" "--mem=2G"         
#> [4] "--time=00:30:00"  
as_slurm_flags(res, array_indices = c(2L, 4L))
#> [1] "--array=2,4"       "--cpus-per-task=1" "--mem=2G"         
#> [4] "--time=00:30:00"
